connectionCode.description: Connection code — stable across environments, unlike connectionId. By default resolves a connection owned by THIS application; set sharedConnection to resolve it among the shared (application-less) connections instead. Within either namespace, a client-scoped sync (clientId set) prefers its own client's connection, falling back to a global one; a client-less sync only resolves a global connection.

sharedConnection.description: Resolve connectionCode among the shared (application-less) connections instead of this application's own. Requires connectionCode.
